title: Seal wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#7fa8c9'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#a9c9e0'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='76' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#6f97b8' transform='rotate(-20 20 76)'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='76' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#6f97b8' transform='rotate(20 80 76)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='12' ry='5' fill='#6f97b8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='21' fill='#7fa8c9'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='15' fill='#cfe3f0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#1b2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='43' r='3.5' fill='#1b2a3a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#2b3f52'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='51' r='0.9' fill='#4a6b85'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='55' r='0.9' fill='#4a6b85'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='51' r='0.9' fill='#4a6b85'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='55' r='0.9' fill='#4a6b85'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 56 Q50 60 54 56' fill='none' stroke='#2b3f52' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M38 30 L50 6 L62 30 Z' fill='#ff5f7e'/>
  <path d='M41 24 L50 7 L59 24 Z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <path d='M44 18 L50 8 L56 18 Z' fill='#5ec7ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='3.5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='1.5' fill='#ff5f7e'/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x='38' y='28' width='24' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5ec7ff'/>
</svg>
